cls.basis: lists Class 1, 2 and 3; also says "The Fold 1 Plus has a maximum speed of 20 mph out of the box"

under label "TOP SPEED:"; max adjustable, not default

wt.basis: maker footnote: "*The bike weight does not include fenders, kickstands, and pedals." Battery not mentioned either way
under label "TOTAL WEIGHT:"; claimed; review also says "At 67.4 lbs, this bike is heavy" (tested)

motor.basis: peak from "750W/1100W | Peak Motor" on same page

The bike features a powerful 750W hub motor with both torque and cadence sensors.

Like most folding e-bikes, it has a hinged frame with a locking release mechanism.

notes: Maker page is on Black Friday sale ($1,199); regular $1,499 recorded. Maker says 608Wh but 48V x 13Ah = 624Wh, which both reviews use. Maker class is 'Class ⟶ 1/2/3' (value on line after the label, so the standard script doesn't join it; found with a context lookup); default 20 mph + throttle = Class 2; electricbikereview lists it as Class 3 (max adjustable). Maker weight footnote excludes fenders/kickstand/pedals and doesn't say whether the battery is included; electricbikereview lists 'TOTAL WEIGHT: 63 lbs' with 'BATTERY WEIGHT: 10 lbs', implying 63 includes battery; both reviews measured 67.4 lb. Maker FAQ calls the 450 lb figure 'total load' but reviews call it payload; recorded without basis. Peak motor (1100W) value came from a context lookup ('750W/1100W' line preceding 'Peak Motor') not returned by the standard script.
